content.imageAlt: The Seven Stars historic exterior and green
content.subtitle: Community Owned & Operated
paragraphs: Tucked away in the beautiful village of Marsh Baldon, The Seven Stars is everything a great British pub should be. Community-owned and community-run, every pint poured and every plate served is a small act of keeping something genuinely valuable alive.

We believe that a great British pub should do three things well: serve excellent food, pour a proper drink, and make every single person who walks through the door feel welcome. Whether you're joining us for a relaxed Sunday evening or celebrating with friends, our warm atmosphere invites you to stay a while.
content.description: Saved by local residents in 2013, Seven Stars is more than just a pub—it is the vibrant social heart of Marsh Baldon.

content.title: Life at The Seven Stars
highlights: The character of a classic Oxfordshire village.
Warmth of local open fires and aged beams.
A place where everyone is welcome.
More than a meal. More than a drink.
Set beside the village green, welcoming walkers, families, and friends.
content.description: The Seven Stars is the kind of place where time slows down. Set beside the village green, it welcomes walkers fresh from the countryside, families gathering around the table, friends meeting over a pint, and visitors discovering Marsh Baldon for the first time.
content.differentDesc: Walk into The Seven Stars and you'll find the character and warmth of a classic village. Local open fires, aged beams, and the hum of good conversation create an atmosphere that is both nostalgic and vibrantly alive.

content.title: The Backdrop to Life's Celebrations
content.ctaDesc: From intimate dinners to grand celebrations in our private barn, we make every occasion unforgettable. The Seven Stars is a place to come together.
content.ctaHeading: Celebrate your special moments with us.
content.description: From intimate dinners and milestone birthdays to weddings, anniversaries, christenings, and private celebrations—The Seven Stars is a place to come together. For larger gatherings, our private barn offers a characterful setting where every celebration feels truly special.

pages.title: Dining
pages.metaDescription: Fresh seasonal menus, Sunday roasts, and locally sourced Oxfordshire ingredients at The Seven Stars.

content.outdoorDesc: When the weather is kind, there's nowhere better to be than our garden overlooking the village green. Settle in for a leisurely meal, enjoy a drink with friends, or simply take in the peaceful surroundings.

content.title: The Dining Experience
content.description: Our kitchen works with fresh, carefully sourced ingredients, honouring British classics while taking inspiration from across Europe, the Middle East and South Asia.

content.mainQuote: Our kitchen works with fresh, carefully sourced ingredients to craft heartening dishes that become the season to bond together.
content.paragraph1: At their heart, our dishes are rooted in British pub tradition but we love to bring in Middle Eastern, European and South Asian influences that keep things interesting.
content.paragraph2: There's always something to look forward to with scrumptious open sandwiches, wholesome cheese boards and mouthwatering orange and cognac crème brulée.

content.title: Honest food, thoughtfully prepared.
content.introDesc1: At The Seven Stars, every dish begins with fresh, carefully sourced ingredients and a respect for the seasons. Rooted in the traditions of the British pub, our menu is complemented by subtle influences from the Middle East, Europe and South Asia.
content.introDesc2: Whether you're stopping by for a leisurely lunch, a Sunday roast, or ending your meal with our orange and cognac crème brûlée — every plate is prepared with care and designed to be enjoyed together.

content.quote: Food is the ingredient that binds us together, And at Seven Stars, we make sure it's extraordinary.
content.author: Food has always brought people together. At The Seven Stars, we simply make it worth gathering for.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.metaTitle: Our Story | The Seven Stars Marsh Baldon
pages.metaDescription: Discover how the community of Marsh Baldon united to save and operate The Seven Stars.

content.title: Saved by the community. Sustained by its people.
content.subtitle: A Community That Creates Happy Moments
content.description: Our story began when we started looking for ways to bring people together. These community members shared a common interest and shared purpose.

content.title: A Pub by the People, for the People
content.content:
The Seven Stars is one of the few pubs in the country to be owned by the very community it serves. When its future was uncertain, the people of Marsh Baldon came together to secure it, ensuring this much-loved village pub would remain part of local life for generations to come.

That spirit continues to shape everything we do. While our roots are firmly in the village, our doors are open to everyone—whether you're a familiar face or visiting for the very first time. Every meal shared, every pint poured and every gathering held here helps sustain a place that belongs not to one person, but to an entire community.

More than a pub, The Seven Stars is a shared legacy—cared for by its people and enjoyed by all who walk through its doors.
content.introDesc: The Seven Stars is more than a village pub—it is a story of a community coming together to preserve a place they couldn't imagine losing.

timelineSteps.desc: Established as a village pub central to life across Marsh Baldon, Toot Baldon, and Nuneham Courtenay.
timelineSteps.title: 350+ Years of Tradition

timelineSteps.desc: Residents formed the Baldons and Nuneham Community Society (BNCS) to buy and run the pub.
timelineSteps.title: Community Society Formed

timelineSteps.desc: Purchased in March 2013 and restored by villagers, reopening on 30th March 2013 as a revived community hub.
timelineSteps.title: Pub Reopened by Villagers

timelineSteps.desc: Awarded CAMRA Pub of the Year with ongoing enhancements to dining, accessibility, and facilities.
timelineSteps.title: CAMRA Pub of the Year

timelineSteps.desc: A new chapter began under Namit Julka and Sunit Bansode, ensuring Seven Stars stays true to its roots with fresh energy.
